appHome.title: What can we help you find?
appHome.description: Search trusted local services by what you need and where you need it.
appHome.joinDescription: Create an account when you are ready
appHome.businessDescription: Open your dashboard and keep your profile up to date.

hero.title: Find trusted local help without the guesswork.
hero.description: HolaLocal brings customers and local professionals together across Costa del Sol and Gibraltar—with clear identities, multilingual support and privacy at the centre.

services.title: A simpler way to find help—or grow a local business.
services.description: Browse before you register. Create an account only when you are ready to connect or offer your services.

find.title: Find trusted local services
find.description: Discover professionals by service and area, with clearer profiles and fewer dead ends.

customers.title: For customers
customers.description: Save favourites, manage your profile and prepare to contact businesses with a verified identity.

businesses.title: For local businesses
businesses.description: Create one professional profile, describe your services and manage how customers discover you.

region.title: Costa del Sol and Gibraltar, first.
region.description: HolaLocal is shaped around the communities, languages and practical service needs of people who live and work here.

values.languageTitle: Use the language that feels natural.
values.languageDescription: Choose your interface language now. Business communication preferences are ready for responsible translation features later.
values.trustDescription: Browse without an account, share minimal personal data and always know who you are communicating with.

cta.title: Ready to make local services feel easier?
cta.description: Join as a customer, a business, or both. One account works across the HolaLocal app and website.

footer.description: A trusted, multilingual community for finding and offering local services across Costa del Sol and Gibraltar.
